truths.truth: Under umask 022, terminus install into a config directory with no settings.json creates one at mode 0600.
truths.evidence: write_atomically (crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/json_file.rs:652-678) opens its temporary through create_temporary (:666), which opens through terminus_core::owner_only::options() (crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:68; owner_only.rs:68-72 sets FILE_MODE). fill (json_file.rs:681-705) copies a mode only when a target exists and differs from 0600 (:699-702), so a fresh file stays 0600. Test a_settings_file_install_creates_is_owner_only (crates/terminus/tests/install.rs:483) spawns the binary through /bin/sh 'umask 022; exec' (install.rs:94, :181) with no settings.json and asserts 0600 and four hook entries. 'cargo test -p terminus --all-features --test install' at HEAD: 29 passed, 0 failed.

truths.truth: Every file create_temporary opens is 0600 before any byte is written; after install an existing 0644 settings.json is still 0644, its backup is 0600, and the stored version file is 0755; uninstall's writes go through the same path.
truths.evidence: create_temporary is the only file-creating open in install/uninstall: callers are Document::backup (json_file.rs:478), write_atomically (:666, used by overwrite :516-518 and apply :536, which are uninstall's two writes at uninstall.rs:157 and :216) and binary::store (binary.rs:273); uninstall.rs has no direct fs::write/OpenOptions/File::create. copy_into sets 0755 before the rename (binary.rs:366). copy_through (json_file.rs:713) no longer copies the source's mode. Under umask 022, 'cargo test -p terminus --all-features --lib -- --nocapture a_temporary_is_owner_only_from_the_open the_backup_carries_the_bytes_and_is_owner_only a_restored_backup_keeps_the_live_file_mode' passed with no 'skipped:' line (mod.rs:540, json_file.rs:1195, :1222). a_settings_file_keeps_its_own_mode_through_install (install.rs:505) asserts 0644 kept and backup 0600; a_settings_file_install_creates_is_owner_only asserts the version file 0755 (install.rs:498-499). Both pass at HEAD; uninstall suite 19 passed.

truths.truth: terminus data move refuses before asking a destination that is a symlink (with or without a trailing slash), owned by another uid, has any group or world bit, or cannot be listed, leaving the store and pointer as they were; an absent destination or an empty 0700 directory this uid owns is accepted.
truths.evidence: run calls refuse_impossible_destinations (crates/terminus/src/cmd/data.rs:118) before anything is printed (:120) or asked (:129). absolute (:462-477) drops trailing slashes and '.' via components(). refuse_unchecked_destination (:295-350): NotFound accepted (:310), other errors refused (:311), symlink (:313), not a directory (:320), uid from the closure compared (:323-329), mode & 0o077 refused with chmod 700 hint (:330-337), read_dir failure refused, never read as empty (:338-349). uid from own_uid probe in the pointer's directory (:359-398), wired through learn_uid (:113-116). HEAD datamove tests pass (13/13): a_symlink_destination_is_refused_with_or_without_a_trailing_slash (tests/datamove.rs:449), a_destination_open_to_other_accounts_is_refused_with_the_chmod (:472), a_destination_that_cannot_be_listed_is_refused (:490, ran, no skip line), an_empty_owner_only_directory_is_accepted (:521, shows the probe uid matches the real owner), a_trailing_slash_is_dropped_before_the_pointer_is_written (:406); assert_refused_before_asking (:432-444) checks exit 1, no 'move it?', terminus.db at the source, no pointer. Other uid: unit seam a_directory_another_uid_owns_is_refused_and_the_owner_named (data.rs:628) passes. Spot-check: a real 'data move <absent>/ --yes' in a scratch HOME exited 0, created the leaf 0700 and recorded the path without the slash. No Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock change in fe73264..HEAD (D-13).

truths.truth: When the destination is created, replaced or widened while 'move it? [y/N]' waits, answering y is refused and nothing is copied.
truths.evidence: After the answer (data.rs:129) and the lock (:138), the rule runs again (:161) and the result must equal the first Found (:162): absent-then-present (:164-165), present-then-absent (:163), different device/inode (:167, Found at :271-276), and a rule refusal such as new group/world bits (:168) all return before create_destination and copy_tree. Tests a_destination_created_while_the_question_waits_is_refused (tests/datamove.rs:603), a_destination_replaced_while_the_question_waits_is_refused (:615), a_destination_widened_while_the_question_waits_is_refused (:633) pass at HEAD; each pipes stdin, waits for the question line with no sleep (:543-580), then asserts exit 1, 'changed while the question waited', the destination empty, the store at the source and no pointer (:584-597). Mutation: with the second check replaced by Ok(found) at :161, the replaced and widened tests fail.

truths.truth: A destination both checks found absent is created by one exclusive 0700 mkdir in run, so a directory or symlink put there after the second check refuses the move with nothing copied (a816e1d).
truths.evidence: run calls create_destination when found == Found::Nothing (data.rs:176-187), mapping AlreadyExists to the 'changed while the question waited' refusal; create_destination (:485-494) is a non-recursive DirBuilder with DIR_MODE. Spot-check 1: strace -e mkdir on a real 'data move <scratch>/newparent/dest/ --yes' showed mkdir(.../dest, 0700) = 0 first, then copy_tree's owner_only::create_dir_all mkdir(.../dest, 0700) = -1 EEXIST; stat gave dest 700. Spot-check 2: strace -P <dest> -e inject=mkdir:error=EEXIST:when=1 made the binary print '<dest> changed while the question waited, so nothing was copied: it was not there and now is', exit 1, the store dir held only LOCK and no pointer/config dir was written. Unit tests a_directory_already_at_the_destination_is_not_taken (data.rs:671) and a_symlink_already_at_the_destination_is_not_taken (:678) pass.

truths.evidence: All run in a git-archive export of HEAD in the scratchpad. #64: HEAD's tests/install.rs against 3322699^ mod.rs and json_file.rs under umask 022: a_settings_file_install_creates_is_owner_only FAILED 'settings.json is 644' (install.rs:497) and a_settings_file_keeps_its_own_mode_through_install FAILED 'the backup is 644' (:525); 27 others passed. truths.truth: THREAT-MODEL.md states correctly when the unchecked parent directory lets another account swap the destination.
truths.evidence: THREAT-MODEL.md:102 says an account that can write to a parent with no sticky bit 'can rename the checked directory away after the copy', and :103 says anything put at the path after the second check fails the mkdir. In the code the window opens earlier. For an existing destination nothing creates the leaf exclusively: copy_tree (data.rs:511) calls owner_only::create_dir_all, which accepts AlreadyExists when path.is_dir() (crates/terminus-core/src/owner_only.rs:54), and is_dir follows a symlink. For an absent destination the same call runs after create_destination (data.rs:177 then :189). So an account that can rename entries in the parent can swap in a symlink to its own directory between the second check (or the mkdir) and the copy, and copy_file (:538-545) writes the archive through it. The doc reads as if the only exposure starts after the copy. This is a reading of the code; no probe raced it.

gaps.name: THREAT-MODEL.md states correctly when the unchecked parent directory lets another account swap the destination
gaps.reason: behavior wrong (docs) - the stated window starts too late
gaps.evidence: THREAT-MODEL.md:102 says the account can rename the checked directory away 'after the copy'. In the code, copy_tree's owner_only::create_dir_all (crates/terminus/src/cmd/data.rs:511) accepts an existing path or a symlink to a directory (crates/terminus-core/src/owner_only.rs:54), so with a writable non-sticky parent the swap works between the second check (or create_destination, data.rs:177) and the copy, and the archive is written through the swapped-in path. THREAT-MODEL.md:103 reads as if nothing planted after the second check is taken, which holds only until the mkdir.
gaps.missing: Reword THREAT-MODEL.md:102 (and the matching D-09 wording) so the window runs from the second check on, before and after the copy, and qualify :103 so it holds only for an account that cannot rename entries in the parent, such as under a sticky /tmp. No code change is implied.
